messages.text:
[redacted:local-path] Infinite Labyrinth
I need you to evaluate the codebase and tell me where I am going wrong in both the realtime action roguelike/looter-shooter gameplay as well as the Menu/UI/Graphics/Art because the game is technically sound but looks and feels bad and it is difficult to explain to the AI agent in VS Code, there is a fundamental disconnect in communication.
Let me get eyes on the codebase. I'll start by loading the filesystem tools and then doing a deep structural audit.
